_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: 3% base rate of ±2 score moves in 12h windows plus flat 30d change, funding 0.0013%, momentum 50 and F&G 30 show stress without a rung-breaker flush or squeeze.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both lock Denial now; analyst explicit HOLD high-conviction forward, narrative silent on direction
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC holds $77,200 post-OPEX balance and fear_greed stays 25-38 with no 30d momentum break
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding flips negative and fear_greed drops below 24 on a liquidation flush, or fear_greed and momentum both clear 46 on a squeeze
